items.title: Bobby Watson interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, January 19, 1996
items.q: In the 80s he worked with Sam Rivers, Ricky Ford and George Coleman

ctx.x: Bobby Watson is one of the most well known alto saxophonists of his generation. He was born in Lawrence, Kansas in 1953 and received degrees in theory and composition from the University of Miami. His move to New York was rewarded by becoming a member of Art Blakey’s Jazz Messengers. Bobby acted as the group’s musical director, and composed and recorded some of the band’s memorable tunes.
